function solve!(out::Vector{Float64}, x::Vector{Float64})
    n = length(x)
    if n == 0
        return out
    elseif n == 1
        out[1] = x[1]
        return out
    elseif n == 2
        out[1] = x[1]
        out[2] = x[2]
        return out
    end
    
    # Create a temporary copy of x if out overlaps with x to ensure we use original values
    if out === x
        temp = copy(x)
    else
        temp = x
    end
    
    for i in 2:n-1
        out[i] = (temp[i-1] + temp[i] + temp[i+1]) / 3.0
    end
    
    # Endpoints remain unchanged
    out[1] = x[1]
    out[n] = x[n]
    
    return out
end

    if n == 0
        return out
    elseif n == 1
        out[1] = x[1]
        return out

        out[1] = x[1]

    # Create a temporary copy of x if out overlaps with x to ensure we use original values
    if out === x
        temp = copy(x)
    else
        temp = x
    end
    
    for i in 2:n-1
        out[i] = (temp[i-1] + temp[i] + temp[i+1]) / 3.0
    end
    
    # Endpoints remain unchanged
    out[1] = x[1]
    out[n] = x[n]
